title: The Damage Waiver and the Share of an Equipment Rental and Demo Finding Borne by the Guest
content:
The damage waiver on an Equipment Rental and Demo agreement is bought by the day, and what the guest bears of a finding turns on whether it was taken at all and on how many of the dates the kit was out it was actually charged for.

## The rule

Where the agreement shows no damage waiver taken and the rental account carries no waiver entry against it, the guest bears the whole of the amount left. The bare cover share is 100 per cent.

Where the waiver was taken, but the rental account carries the waiver charged for fewer dates than that account shows the kit was out, the guest bears the partial cover share of the amount left instead. The partial cover share is 60 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the share the guest bears.

## The conditions in combination

| Waiver shown on the agreement | Waiver entries on the rental account | Dates the waiver was charged for against dates the kit was out | Share of the amount left borne by the guest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| not taken | none | not counted | 100 per cent |
| taken | present | fewer dates charged than dates out | 60 per cent |
| taken | present | as many dates charged as dates out, or more | nothing under this heading |

The first row asks two things of the record together: the agreement shows no waiver taken, and no waiver entry stands on the rental account. The second row is a plain comparison of two counts on that same account, the dates the waiver was charged for against the dates the kit was out.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical agreement

Take an agreement where 89.00 USD is left when this heading is reached, and on which the account carries 6 dates the kit was out.

- The agreement shows no waiver and the account carries no waiver entry: the guest bears the whole 89.00 USD.
- The agreement shows the waiver taken and the account carries the waiver charged for 4 dates: 4 is fewer than 6, so the guest bears 60 per cent of 89.00 USD, that is 53.40 USD.
- The agreement shows the waiver taken and the account carries the waiver charged for 6 dates: 6 is not fewer than 6, so nothing under this heading changes the share.

## Point of judgement

**A waiver charged for more dates than the kit was out.** More dates charged than dates out is not fewer dates charged than dates out, so that agreement sits with the last row of the table.
